title: US Container Drayage Rates
description:
Container drayage price statistics by distance and terminal, fuel surcharge practice and accessorial fee figures (Transportli). CC BY 4.0.

Aggregate tables with a source_url column on every row that points to the Transportli page explaining the numbers. These are quotes and posted prices, not booked prices. Canonical source and method: https://transportli.com/blog/drayage-rates-study/. Also on Hugging Face: Transportli/us-container-drayage-rates.
